notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics SaaS. Looking to replace self-hosted transformer endpoints to reduce ops cost and improve latency consistency. Runways: aggressive PLG growth next 12 months.

Sales/negotiation notes:
- Customer evaluated Hosted API first; POC shows good perf but wants predictable unit economics -> exploring Dedicated.
- Primary asks from finance: explicit commit tiers, clear burst pricing, overage cap option, 3-month ramp schedule, ability to scale dedicated pool without renegotiating base price.
- Proposed commit levels discussed: 50M tokens/month (base), 150M tokens/month (preferred), burst up to 300M tokens for traffic spikes; staggered ramp: month1 50%, month2 75%, month3 full commit.
- Overage: customer asked for blended overage at 1.25x base rate up to 120% of commit, then 1.5x thereafter; also requested a monthly overage credit if average utilization remains under 60% (finance ask).
- Burst mechanics: want shared burst across zones with per-minute throttling and predictable billing window (1-minute granularity). Blocker: wants explicit definition of 'burst' events for SRE acceptance testing.
- Security: VPC peering + KMS for model keys; SOC2 + audit logging required. Data residency: requests EU region for EU customers (secondary requirement, not blocking initial NA deployment).
- Performance targets: p95 <200ms for chat gen at typical session length (avg 120 tokens), throughput 20-30 rps for peak UI flows. POC numbers: p95 ~120ms, steady throughput 18-22 rps depending on batch config.
- Pricing sensitivity: target blended cost per 1k tokens must beat current cloud-hosted GPU costs by ~20% after factoring reserved commit.
- Legal: wants a 30-day SLA credit clause and ability to terminate for convenience at 60 days with pro-rated refund if capacity not delivered.

Quotes / direct lines from calls:
- "We like the control promises of Dedicated but need a billing model we can forecast into FY27." — Head of Platform
- "If you give us a predictable ramp and burst cap, we can move to a 12-month commit." — VP Finance

Artifacts to share: pricing calc spreadsheet, dedicated SLA draft, burst definition doc, sample ramp schedule. SE Diego preparing a delta doc comparing Hosted POC vs proposed Dedicated perf/cost.
